items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: he didn't bother much with us... we never heard, uh, once, I believe we heard from him once. That's it all.

ctx.x: What about Pills' brother, Ninny Quacko? You remember Ninny?

Yeah, Ninny Quacko. Well, Ninny Quacko was, uh, was alright, but, uh, he didn't bother much with us. You see? It was a guy mistaken. The Ninny went off, and Ninny Quacko went off here with a shoe. Mm-hmm. That's years ago. And, uh, you know, we never heard, uh, once, I believe we heard from him once. That's it all.
He's out in California last year, and I believe he's alive out in Los Angeles.
